dataset.description: Cross-sectional survey of adults on the influence of religious leaders and religious belief on COVID-19 vaccine uptake and on routine childhood immunisation. One row per individual respondent, fielded in ten countries: Brazil, Egypt, Guatemala, Iraq, Kenya, Mali, Nepal, Nigeria, Pakistan and Zambia. Two gated branches: a non-uptake-reasons branch for the unvaccinated, and a child-vaccination battery for parents of under-fives.
